relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman
relations.evidence: educated at Taunton School in Somerset and Downing College, Cambridge, receiving his M.A. in 1954.

relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman
relations.evidence: The whole of his academic career was spent at Cambridge. He was appointed Lecturer in Indian Studies in 1955

relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman
relations.evidence: Lecturer in Indian Studies in 1955, Reader in 1978, and Professor of Indian Studies in 1990.

relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman
relations.evidence: Reader in 1978, and Professor of Indian Studies in 1990. He retired in 1992.

relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman
relations.evidence: From 1981 to 1994 he was President of the Pali Text Society

relations.subject: Kenneth Roy Norman

relations.evidence: from January to March 1994 he was the Bukkyō Dendō Kyōkai Visiting Professor at the School of Oriental and African Studies.
